text:
sam: :rotating_light: Observed a regression — embeddings token-mapper is returning null for ~5% of short inputs in prod since 03:10 UTC. Rolling a tiny patch to guard against empty tokens. Need quick approvals for a micro-release during the 04:00-05:00 change window.

maria: Can you paste the minimal changelist and the rollout plan? I need that for the release notes and to surface to SRE.

sam: Patch is a 3-line fix in `token_mapper.py` to default to `['<unk>']` when the token list is empty. No model changes, no migration. Canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 20min.

chandra: Ops: any objections to doing this in the morning window? Is there capacity for manual rollback if something weird happens?

ops-oncall: We have a spare surge slot at 04:15 UTC. If the canary shows errors >1% for two consecutive 5m buckets we can cutover back to previous image and throttle new requests. Keep me in loop.

release-manager: Please post the short release note blurb here and add the `revert` command we'll use in case. Also include the deploybot approval token below so I can sign off.

sam: Release note: "Fix: token-mapper returns placeholder for empty token lists to prevent embedding failures (prod)."

sam: Revert command (if needed): ``kubectl set image deploy/embedder embedder=embedder:2026.03.18-prev``

sam: Deploybot, request approvals for `embedder:2026.03.18-hotfix-tokenguard` with canary policy `10/20/100` and tag `urgent-micro`.

deploybot: @sam request received. To approve, owners must react with :thumbsup: or reply `approve`. Approval window: 30m. Approvers required: release-manager, ops-oncall, one eng lead.

nathan: approve — I ran the unit + smoke for the branch, logs look clean locally.

maria: approve from docs/release note perspective. I'll push the short blurb to the release notes page.

release-manager: approve. Leaving a note: watch `embedder.errors` and `embed_latency_p95` during canary.

ops-oncall: approve. I'll be standing by at 04:10 UTC and will pause traffic if we see anomaly.

deploybot: All approvals collected. Scheduling rollout for 04:15 UTC (canary 10% for 5m -> 50% 10m -> 100% 5m). Deployment ID: `deploy-6110000000-a1`.

sam: Pushing image now and will trigger deploybot when tag is ready. Posting docker digest in here when done.

sam: Image pushed: `sha256:3f7a...b9e1`. Triggering deploybot.

deploybot: Trigger accepted. Starting canary. Notifying SLO alerting.

ops-oncall: Canary 5m metrics look good: errors 0.6%, latency stable. Proceeding to 50%.

chandra: Thumbs up from infra side. Keeping a 20m post-deploy watch.

maria: Release notes updated and small customer-facing blurb queued.

sam: Thanks everyone. If anyone sees anything odd ping me and mark thread `deploy-6110000000` for postmortem follow-up. :thumbsup:

deploybot: Canary complete. Rollout to 100% finished at 04:41 UTC. No rollback triggered. Deployment closed.
